newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-Aug consumer prices up 4.6 pct vs yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-Aug consumer prices up 4.6 pct vs yr-ago.

text.p: Chilean consumer prices rose 0.4 percent in August bringing the increase in the first eight months of the year to 4.6 percent compared with 6.4 percent in the same period 1995, said the National Statistics Institute.

The figure showed inflation slowing sharply in August against the 1.6 percent rise recorded in the same month last year and is a good sign that the government will meet its target of 6.5 percent this year.
Consumer prices rose 6.4 percent over the 12 months ending in August compared with 8.5 percent in the year ending in August 1995.
The 0.4 percent rise in August, down from 0.3 percent in July, was in line with most expectations.

The Central Bank has kept a tight rein on credit most of this year to fight inflation, and acting Central Bank President Jorge Marshall said last month the bank had no plans in the near-term to relax rates despite its success in cooling inflation.
